("Merger Sub"), pursuant to which, among other transactions, Merger Sub will merge with and into Livent, with Livent surviving the merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of NewCo (the "merger"), and each share of Livent common stock, par value $0.001 per share, other than certain excluded shares, will be converted into the right to receive 2.406 ordinary shares, par value $1.00 per share, of NewCo (the "NewCo Shares"), and approve the transactions contemplated by the Transaction Agreement, including the merger (collectively, the "Transaction") (Proposal 1).
